I was so happy with the shelf, I bought a second one. Good quality at an inexpensive price. Great for storage of my dvd/bluray collection. I have it set up with 18 shelves with 20 dvds per shelf. Ordering 2 of these shelves was still less expensive than other options out there.
Looks good, perfect fit. Easy assembly and arrived on time.

Great product. Feels fairly sturdy. I just have 2 complaints. The 1st one is that I wish the peg holes went all the way down for a fully customizable experience instead of stopping a little under a foot. My 2nd complaint is that i wish the shelves would fit a lot better on the pegs. I had a couple times where the board came loose. Either a slightly thicker shelf or maybe finding a better way for the shelf to secure on the peg would have helped.

Bon produit mais on ne peut qu'utilise la parti de la rallonge pour coudre sans être gêner par les étagère, et par conséquent la table tremble quand on coud, manque un pied de support sur le coin as droite pour éviter cela. La table fermer très Béa meuble et déplie et se déplace facilement

La he usado un par de veces en ambas ocasiones ha sido un éxito monumental. He realizado tandas de 3 de palomitas, evidentemente se ha apagado cuando hace el último pop, volviéndola a encender para hacer mas palomitas tras retirar las del cofre. Bonito acabado, y me ha sido fácil montaje, desmonto todo cuando la limpio es mejor y esperando a que esté fria. Hay que pensar que es una máquina para hogar/juguete de adultos, no una máquina industrial

Klappt sehr gut. Hat uns für den Kindergeburtstag mit 10 Kids ausreichend Popcorn geliefert. Mehrfach hintereinander gefüllt. Und ist auch immer ne tolle Aktion. Auch für den Familien Kino Abend sehr praktisch. Einfach zu reinigen.

The most significant aspect of this chair is the incredible quality, of both the build and the materials. I am over 100kg and there is no problem with this chair easily accommodating me. It folds away handily, is very comfortable, easy to adjust the angle of the backrest and footrest, and it is easy to lock and unlock in the desired position. The folding legs are a separate mechanism from the reclining parts, they can be locked in position, and are extremely stable and sturdy. The detachable shelf is handy as it holds two cups as well as a phone and tablet. The cushion is easily removable for washing, or even if you wanted to replace it with one of your own choosing. I have even customized my chair by adding a pool noodle to the footrest for additional soft padding!

Dernièrement j'ai acheté cette chaisse longue. El est bien pratique et on est bien assis ou couché dessus. Une observation la barre du bas aurais mité d'être recouverte d'un tissus, car parfois mes pied son en contacte avec la barre est crée une douleur. Le support à gobelet meriterais d'être un peu plus grand. Autrement elle est parfaite
